Question: The best conclusion that can be drawn about the four-day ( compressed) workweek is that it has:

Options: 
A. negative effects on productivity but little or no impact on attitudes.
B. positive effects on productivity but negative effects on attitudes.
C. long-lasting negative effects on attitudes and productivity.
D. positive effects on attitudes but little or no impact on productivity.
E. positive effects on productivity but little or no impact on attitudes.
F. negative effects on attitudes but positive effects on productivity.
G. no significant effects on either attitudes or productivity.
H. negative effects on attitudes initially but, over time, increasingly positive effects on both attitudes and productivity.
I. positive effects on attitudes initially but, over time, increasingly negative effects on both attitudes and productivity.
J. long-lasting positive effects on attitudes and productivity.

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
